payers_information.standard_charge_algorithm: Fee schedule rate ($444.91).    This procedure could have the diagnostic imaging rule applied to it.  When the diagnostic imaging rule is applied, diagnostic imaging procedures are grouped based on their Diagnostic Imaging Family Indicator (typically based on the value from the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule). This procedure's family indicator is 88. Then within each group, procedures are paid by splitting them into their Professional Component (PC) and Technical Component (TC). To rank the procedures, it splits the technical and professional components and calculates the allowed amounts for each procedure. To evaluate the technical component, the allowed amount is calculated as if the charge had a TC modifier. For the Professional Component it does the same with a 26 modifier. It then ranks the procedures by the sum of the resulting technical and professional components. The highest priced procedure is reimbursed at 100%, for both components. Subsequent procedures within the family have a defined PC percentage applied to their PC part, and a defined TC percentage applied to their TC part.  The first of the following criteria that the procedure qualifies for will determine if the diagnostic imaging rule is applied, the PC%, and the TC%:  Meets criteria defined by "SHC PB NON PCTC SPLIT PROCS": Applies; PC% of 95%; TC% of 50%;  Default: Does not apply        If the allowed amount exceeds the billed amount, it will be capped at the billed amount.
